images.seen: Africa and Arabia at the start of the window look right: SADR/Morocco hatching in Western Sahara, Ugandan/Rwandan occupation hatching in the DRC, SPLM south of Sudan, Halaib with Egypt; no speckle, no missing state.

Somaliland drawn across all of Sool and Sanaag including the Maakhir coast that Puntland incorporated in January 2009 (66 cells, size rule wrong; ruled to Puntland); Iraq whole with no Kurdistan Region drawn; Cliopatria draws Iraq as United States land, the compiled map correctly does not.

Forces Nouvelles hold the north of Cote d'Ivoire as drawn from the ledger; the DRC is drawn whole at the end of 2002 (the rebel-held east and north of 1998-2003 have no dossier, the contest has 0 cells); Ituri occupation closed too early (patched).

Caucasus fine: Abkhazia and South Ossetia independent, Artsakh with the occupied districts hatched, the August 2008 Russian occupation of Georgia closed by year end; two Georgian cells left inside Abkhazia (Kodori) are too small to patch.
Afghanistan whole at the end of 2001 apart from a 12-cell hole in Takhar (Taloqan area) left nobody's by the Taliban dissolve; filled by the 2002 keyframe, one year-end only.
After the patch Puntland holds the eastern Sanaag coast (Maakhir) and Somaliland the rest of the protectorate.
After the patch the Mexico-United States border is clean: no United States cells in Mexico, no strip of New Mexico/Texas/Colorado in Mexico, no holes on the Mexican side.

issues.what: mexico/ledger/9 ('six islands in the Rio Grande', 24 Nov 2009) resolves as the whole Rio Grande plus 5 km and hands Mexico 96 US cells (New Mexico 44, Texas 34, Colorado 14); six islands are far under one 253 km2 cell.

The start anchor of 2000 gives the United States 61 cells whose centres lie in Mexico along the Rio Grande (Chihuahua 17, Coahuila 15, Tamaulipas 14, others); the US 2006 keyframe snap then drops them to nobody (hole in Mexico from 2006). Cause is the border fit of the US shape from about 1973 (anchors 1980 to 1999 hold the same 61).

Cliopatria's Russian Federation shapes stop at the 180th meridian: keyframe russian-federation_2000 snapped 412 Chukotka cells away (new snap once the p1990-p1999 Chukotka overrides are in) and the 2006 shape does the same.

Kurdistan Region has no land from the dissolve of the Iraqi Republic in October 2005 (iraqi-republic ledger/15 region is all of Iraq and hands the Region's 144 cells to the Republic of Iraq), although the page says the 2005 constitution kept 'its existing authorities established in 1992' and the hierarchy row makes it a constituent of Iraq; the relation had 0 cells.

puntland_2009 keyframe claims Maakhir (66 cells of the eastern Sanaag coast) but the whole-protectorate Somaliland keyframe claims the same cells and the smaller state won; the page says Maakhir was incorporated into Puntland in January 2009.

22 further cells (Nugaal 19, Mudug 3) between 7.4N and 8.5N near Garowe stay with Somaliland: somaliland ledger/3 (Las Anod, October 2007) uses a 120 km disc that reaches into Puntland's Nugaal and Mudug. The Puntland page does not draw the frontline and the Somaliland page only says its troops took the town of Las Anod.

Uganda's occupation of the DRC is closed in full at the Luanda Agreement (September 2002) because the dossier found no withdrawal date; the Second Congo War page says Ugandan troops remained in early 2003, the UPDF stormed Bunia on 6 March 2003 and Uganda withdrew from Ituri on 2 June 2003. Ituri (199 cells) reopened as occupied from September 2002 to June 2003.

RCD-Goma, MLC and RCD-ML (the rebel-held east, Equateur and north of the DRC, 1998 to 2003) have no dossiers: the DRC contest 'RCD and MLC rebels with Rwanda and Uganda' has 0 cells and the DRC is drawn whole from the end of 2002.

Japan vs Russia size-rule conflict (7 cells: 3 on the Korsakov end of south Sakhalin, Tyuleniy Island, 3 southern Kuril cells; Japan won 14 cell-years in 2000 and 2006). A ruling for Russia was written and checked, then withdrawn: with the other windows' patches in the trial the conflict no longer arises.
Egypt wins the Halaib Triangle (86 cells) against Sudan's 2005 keyframe, which re-includes it; Egypt has administered it since January 2000 per the Sudan ledger.
Sudan is drawn whole from January 2005 with the autonomous south (keyframe republic-of-sudan_2005, by design) and the SPLM dossier ends; no separate Government of Southern Sudan is drawn.

Small snaps and conflicts of border fit, each 1 percent or less of the state: afghanistan_2002 (+29 cells, 16 of them Pakistani), kazakhstan_2006 (+23, about 10 Uzbek), montenegro_2006 (+4), kingdom-of-bahrain_2001 (+1, the Hawar Islands after the ICJ judgment, correct), tamil-eelam_2009 (-1), Georgia/Turkey Ardahan 2 cells, Armenia/Turkey 3, Kazakhstan/China 6, the Forces Nouvelles conflicts with Mali, Guinea, Burkina Faso (the smaller state, the rebels, rightly wins). None moves 200 cells; no page opened.

Skipped and unresolved events: eritrea Barentu contest start and end (both inside 2000, no effect at a year end), the Bagys exchange (kazakhstan and uzbekistan 2002, a village), Uzengi-Kuush (kyrgyzstan 2009), the Hawar and Qatar items of 2001 (no land cell), the russian-occupied-territories umbrella.

dossier_requests.what: Fix the region of ledger/9 (24 November 2009): the six Rio Grande islands cover far less than one grid cell, so the event should move no land (drop it, or give a region that resolves to nothing).
dossier_requests.why: The region {river Rio Grande, km 5} resolves to the whole river plus 5 km and moves 96 US cells (New Mexico 44, Texas 34, Colorado 14). Patched in p2000-p2009 events/1 (and p2020-p2029 events/3, now a no-op).

dossier_requests.what: ledger/15 (dissolve, 2005) has the region all of Iraq (Cliopatria Iraqi Republic 2000) and takes the Kurdistan Region's 144 cells with it; and ledger/14 'gain' of the Region should be a vassal_start (federal region) or be dropped. Subtract the Region's three governorates from the dissolve region.
dossier_requests.why: The page says the Region kept 'its existing authorities established in 1992' and no land changes hands; hierarchy.csv already has the Region as a constituent of Iraq from 2005. Patched in p2000-p2009 events/2 (applies from 1 January 2006).

dossier_requests.what: ledger/3 (Las Anod, October 2007) uses a 120 km disc around Las Anod that also takes 22 Nugaal and Mudug cells of Puntland; narrow it to Las Anod and the Sool lands.
dossier_requests.why: The page names only the town of Las Anod; the Puntland keyframe puts Nugaal and Mudug in Puntland. Needs a page that draws the 2007-2009 frontline; the pages opened are silent.

dossier_requests.what: Add dossiers for the rebel states of the Second Congo War: RCD-Goma (the Kivus and Maniema), MLC (Equateur and the north) and RCD-ML (Ituri), 1998 to July 2003, so the contest of 1998-2003 has land.
dossier_requests.why: The page says the RCD-Goma captured Moliro and Rwanda Pweto in 2000, that Equateur was 'mostly controlled by Bemba and the UPDF', and that the war ended on 18 July 2003 with the Transitional Government; the DRC ledger's contest counterpart is only a name, so it has 0 cells.

problems: The 61 Mexican-side cells held by the United States are in the anchors from 1980 (14 cells from about 1900); events/0 gives them back to Mexico from 1 January 2000 and is a no-op if p1980-p1989 or p1990-p1999 fixes the cause (the US shape of about 1973 to 2023). The earlier windows still draw them as US land until then.

keyframe_overrides/1 (russian-federation_2006) changes the shape of 2006 to 2013, so it reaches into p2010-p2019; the 2014 and 2024 Russian shapes (russian-federation_2014, russian-federation_2024) lack Chukotka east of 180 degrees in the same way (412 cells at each snap), for the p2010-p2019 and p2020-p2029 agents.

events/2 (kurdistan-region, 1 January 2006) is dated after the 2005 dissolve that takes the land, so the end of 2005 still draws the Region absorbed; the p2010-p2019 event dated 1 January 2010 becomes a no-op; the p2020-p2029 Mexico loss of 2020 becomes a no-op after events/1.

Trial against the shared drafts also showed three new size-rule conflicts that come from other windows' patches or later dossier edits, not from this patch: central-african-republic / republic-of-sudan (12 cell-years, CAR wins), republic-of-chad / republic-of-sudan (2), republic-of-turkey / united-states-of-america (1); all rightly won by the smaller state.
hierarchy: no wrong row found in this window (kurdistan-region under republic-of-iraq from 2005 is right; its 0 cells came from the dossier dissolve, not the row).
